name: Deep Imaskari
sourceDistinctions: Table 1–1 on p. 6 lists −2 Strength. The racial traits on p. 9 specify −2 Dexterity. This profile uses the racial text.
The book describes a human subrace. Medium Humanoid (Human) follows from that description. No racial Hit Dice or positive level adjustment is listed.
Spell Clutch re-prepares a previously prepared and cast 1st-level spell. The standard-action activation follows the core supernatural ability rule.
Wizards’ collected archive has no Underdark errata file. The official FAQ has no Deep Imaskari or Spell Clutch entry.
